blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines, October 13, 2026 — In a landmark recognition of its contribution to the city’s growth, property giant Megaworld’s 30-hectare The Mactan Newtown has been officially declared the ‘Tourism, Culture, and Investment Capital of Lapu-Lapu City’ under Executive Order No. 2026-072, signed by Lapu-Lapu City Mayor Ma. Cynthia ‘Cindi’ Chan. The Executive Order recognizes the township’s significant role in promoting tourism, providing a venue for cultural appreciation and activities, and attracting investments that contribute to significant employment and economic development of Lapu-Lapu City. It also underscores The Mactan Newtown’s contribution to helping strengthen Lapu-Lapu City’s identity as a dynamic destination […]...
